security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks, path placeholders, and normal translation guidance. The confirmed risks are three Bash workflow snippets that run local helper scripts or delete generated temporary files. No prompt injection, encoded payload, network access, or credential exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Bash snippets execute local helper scripts on user files.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation, quote all paths, and prefer direct tool invocation or a wrapper with strict path validation.

remediation.issue: Cleanup uses rm -rf with relative paths.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve the intended source directory first and delete only generated files after verifying each target path.

content.value_statement: Long documents lose tone and terminology when translated in pieces. This skill builds a glossary, brief, and segment workflow for consistent Markdown translation.
actual_capabilities: Translates Markdown and plain text between any language pair, with Chinese as the default target.
Creates a temporary glossary and translation brief before translation.
Splits files over 1000 lines into Markdown-safe segments for parallel translation.
Uses locale references for zh-CN, zh-TW, zh-HK, zh-SG, and zh-MY.
Merges translated segments and checks headings, code fences, and links.
Preserves code blocks, links, YAML frontmatter, and Markdown structure.
limitations: It expects Markdown or plain text; other formats must be converted first.
Large-file workflows require user confirmation before parallel processing.
It uses local Python helper scripts for splitting and merging.
It does not validate translation accuracy against external sources.

use_cases.title: Translate Technical Documentation
use_cases.description: Convert developer docs into Chinese while preserving terms, code blocks, links, and Markdown structure.

use_cases.title: Localize Product Content
use_cases.description: Adapt README files and product copy for a specific Chinese-speaking locale with consistent vocabulary.

use_cases.title: Process Long Research Notes
use_cases.description: Split large Markdown files into segments, translate them in parallel, and merge the final document.

prompt_templates.title: Translate a Short File
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single Markdown file.
prompt_templates.prompt: Translate my Markdown file into Simplified Chinese. Preserve headings, links, tables, and code blocks.

prompt_templates.title: Set Target Locale
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request with regional style requirements.
prompt_templates.prompt: Translate this README into Traditional Chinese for Taiwan. Use Taiwan terminology and keep the Markdown format unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Translate a Documentation Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for multiple related files.
prompt_templates.prompt: Translate these documentation files into Chinese. Build one shared glossary and keep terminology consistent across every file.

prompt_templates.title: Run Large-File Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for a long document that needs segmentation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Translate this large Markdown manual into Chinese. Confirm the split plan, translate each segment, merge the result, and run a quality review.

output_examples.input: Translate a short product README to zh-CN.
output_examples.output: A translated README with preserved Markdown, consistent product terms, and a brief note about key terminology choices.

output_examples.input: Translate a long tutorial with many headings and code blocks.
output_examples.output: Segment translations are merged into one Chinese document, with headings, links, and code fences checked after merge.

output_examples.input: Translate a blog post for Taiwan readers.
output_examples.output: A Traditional Chinese translation that uses Taiwan vocabulary and keeps the original conversational tone.

best_practices: State the target language and locale before translation begins.
Review glossary choices before approving long or batch translations.
Confirm the split plan before processing large files.
anti_patterns: Do not send PDFs or images without converting them to Markdown first.
Do not skip glossary preparation for technical documents.
Do not run cleanup before checking translated outputs.

faq.question: What file types does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports Markdown and plain text. Other formats should be converted to Markdown first.

faq.question: What is the default target language?
faq.answer: The default target language is Simplified Chinese for Mainland China.

faq.question: Can it translate to languages other than Chinese?
faq.answer: Yes. Specify the target language and locale in your request.

faq.question: How does it handle long files?
faq.answer: It can split long Markdown files, translate segments in parallel, and merge the translated result.

faq.question: Does it preserve code blocks?
faq.answer: Yes. It preserves code blocks and does not translate code block contents.

faq.question: Does it update a glossary?
faq.answer: It can suggest new terms and asks before writing them to the persistent glossary.
